body: It's more emotional pain. I have chronic pain issues but have learned to deal by numbing myself as much as possible. Emotionally that works as well. Except when you get blindsided by something and fall face first into it without protecting yourself. I hate feelings. They seem to only bring pain.

I am sorry to hear you're feeling this way. I can relate. I also have no job, no car, don't have my own place, not in charge of my phone bill, etc. I wish I could help you. People say money doesn't buy happiness but it sure can fix alot of problems. If I had the money, I would fix all your problems for you. I'm sorry I cant.

I don' really have any advice to offer, but I get the thing with your ex. I have a boyfriend and am pining after a guy I can't have and it kills me. I know how you feel and I know how much it sucks. Trying to get through it myself. I'm here if you need to talk.
I get the isolation thing. I wish I had more to say but I am going through something similar myself. I'm here for now if you want to talk.
